summary: impact-aware testing facility with surface inventory, change routing, flake policy, timing history, and process-model docs
summary_highlight: testing observatory: affected selection, surface inventory, timing history, process policy

basis_witness.source: rev0004 BrowserRT cube plus current testing-facility research pass
basis_witness.omission_basis: No external code imported; researched sources were used only as design pressure.
basis_witness.basis_state: sufficient for impact-aware cloudtainer test-facility scaffold

scope_witness.active_request: Keep thinking over everything that will need to be tested and continue growing the facility and process.
scope_witness.exact_target: Next BrowserRT revision with test surface inventory, affected-test routing, flake policy, timing history, and clearer browser/process/benchmark posture.
ambient_exclusions: No long-lived process reliance across turns

primary_risks: under-selecting tests from a changed-file heuristic
over-fitting timing budgets to the current cloudtainer
flake quarantine becoming a hiding place
future browser tests arriving as monoliths
benchmark numbers being mistaken for correctness or public performance claims
risk_witness.repair: Keep selection explanatory, quarantine empty by default, separate benchmark/stress/correctness evidence, and require each expensive future subsystem to start as one small manifest task.

non_claims: Not a browser CDP test harness yet
Not a persistent cross-turn process model
Not a remote-cache or remote-execution system
